summary: Retest of SQL-018 spot-unlock hardening after @testing-library/dom@10.4.2 was added and frontend restarted. Full backend pytest suite (39 passed), full root `yarn test` vitest suite (6 files, 55 passed, including arcade.test.ts which was previously blocked), frontend typecheck, root yarn install --frozen-lockfile, health/public-key/admin-401 curls, and all 5 previously-created named browser checks (reran by name only, no script changes) all passed. No regressions, no new bugs. The only remaining gap is unchanged from iteration_27: real Supabase SQL 018 execution and a real test account are still not available to this environment.

checks.criterion: Locked spot UI shows server-derived price and balance
checks.name: locked-spot-shows-server-price-free-and-paid
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check unchanged: Scenario A (unlocked_count<10) -> spot-unlock-price text exactly 'Free unlock', coin-balance-display shows balance, spot-unlock-button visible. Scenario B (11th spot) -> spot-unlock-price text exactly 'Unlock for 150 Coins'. 2 screenshots captured.

checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check unchanged: after first click spot-unlock-button has aria-busy='true' and disabled; forced second click recorded no extra RPC call; after resolve spot-locked-panel disappears and details render; unlockCalls===1.

checks.criterion: Unlock errors are bilingual and specific
checks.name: src/lib/arcade.test.ts (root yarn test / vitest)
checks.evidence: `cd /app && yarn test` -> vitest run: Test Files 6 passed (6), Tests 55 passed (55), including src/lib/arcade.test.ts (6 tests, 8ms) which asserts the 42702/ambiguous -> SQL 018 guidance, INSUFFICIENT_COINS -> clear bilingual message, and network failure -> 'coin balance was not changed' / 'Guthaben wurde nicht verändert' mappings. Previously blocked in iteration_27 by missing @testing-library/dom; now resolved and passing, no longer a gap.

checks.name: test_tscheck_sql018_migration_rules.py
checks.evidence: Included in full backend suite run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q` -> 39 passed in 3.67s (includes the 9 static-file assertions against docs/migrations/018_spot_unlock_hardening.sql: security definer, restricted EXECUTE grants, wallet FOR UPDATE, 10-free/150-paid formula, INSUFFICIENT_COINS raise, idempotent ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING insert, insert->debit->ledger ordering, no RLS-disable statement).
